provenance.method: Independent source and contract review by a separate agent, followed by inline local JSON/quotation/role/scope/hash checks. No repository runtime or evaluator was imported or executed.
provenance.read_scope: Two supplied contracts, supplied freeze record, all 19 corpus Markdown documents, and the fresh holdout after explicit authorship-complete handoff only.
provenance.preparation: Contracts, freeze and full corpus were reviewed before opening holdout.json. No decision was written during preparation.
provenance.context_limitations: Standing system/developer and repository/environment instructions were supplied with the isolated task. No parent task transcript, repository history, prior questions, answers or outcomes were requested or used as validation evidence. The permitted freeze itself contains file names, hashes and measurement metadata; none of its referenced non-permitted files were opened.
provenance.hashes: Every files_read hash is SHA-256 of actual raw file bytes. All 19 corpus hashes match freeze.files. The authoring-contract raw CRLF hash differs from freeze.files; replacing CRLF with LF exactly reproduces the frozen hash. No substantive contract drift was found.
provenance.historical_overlap: Not independently checked: prior suites are excluded inputs. Root performs the mechanical historical overlap check separately.
provenance.temporal_custody: authored_after_freeze matches supplied freeze commit. No Git history or independent authorship timeline was inspected. Authorship completion relies on the explicit handoff.
provenance.application_limit: This decision validates source-grounded expectations, not runtime success, ingestion outcomes, actual permission enforcement, or live separate-project fixture placement.
provenance.scope_limit: Every case is Northstar project scoped with null department_id. This suite contains no deliberately narrowed department case and does not independently demonstrate department-isolation coverage.
provenance.human_limit: Agent validation, not expert human adjudication.
